58568395.name: 3,4,5-Trimethylphenethylamine
58568395.description: 3,4,5-Trimethylphenethylamine (also known as TMePEA and 3,4,5-tris-desoxymescaline) is a chemical compound of the phenethylamine family.

59866315.name: 6,14-Endoethenotetrahydrooripavine
59866315.description: 6,14-Endoethenotetrahydrooripavine is the central nucleus, or backbone, of a class of morphinan opioids known as the Bentley compounds and may be considered their "privileged scaffold".

70811211.name: XEN-D0101
70811211.description: XEN-D0101 is an experimental drug that was developed to treat atrial fibrillation.

71498955.name: Lu AF35700
71498955.description: Lu AF35700, also known as d8-zicronapine, is an experimental antipsychotic which was under development for the treatment of schizophrenia and schizoaffective disorder but was never marketed.

71587019.name: Acetylglycinamide chloral hydrate
71587019.description: Acetylglycinamide chloral hydrate is a hypnotic/sedative. It is a combination of acetylglycinamide and chloral hydrate.

71724875.name: Flubatine
71724875.description: Flubatine is a fluorine-18 labeled radiotracer and radioligand for positron emission tomography imaging, developed as a high-affinity ligand for brain nicotinic acetylcholine receptors of the α4β2...

73442763.name: CMF-019
73442763.description: CMF-019 is a drug which is a selective, small-molecule agonist for the apelin receptor. It is used in research into treatment for heart failure.

75124299.name: Conjugated estrogens/medroxyprogesterone acetate
75124299.description: Conjugated estrogens/medroxyprogesterone acetate , sold under the brand names Prempro and Premphase, is a combination product of conjugated equine estrogens , an estrogen collected from horse urine...

86278347.name: Ropeginterferon alfa-2b
86278347.description: Ropeginterferon alfa-2b, sold under the brand name Besremi, is a medication used to treat polycythemia vera and essential thrombocythemia.

91864651.name: EHP-102
91864651.description: EHP-102, also known as VCE-003.2, is a cannabinoid CB2 receptor agonist and PPARγ agonist which is under development for the treatment of Parkinson's disease and Huntington's disease.

101943115.name: Lithium disilicate
101943115.description: Lithium disilicate is a chemical compound that is a glass ceramic. It is widely used as a dental ceramic due to its strength, machinability and translucency.

101967051.name: Variegatic acid
101967051.description: Variegatic acid is an orange pigment found in some mushrooms.

137332171.name: 3-HO-PCE
137332171.description: 3-Hydroxyeticyclidine is a novel dissociative drug of the arylcyclohexylamine class, related to phencyclidine.

154699467.name: Lufotrelvir
154699467.description: Lufotrelvir is an antiviral drug developed by Pfizer which acts as a 3CL protease inhibitor.

155907915.name: Methylallyltryptamine
155907915.description: Methylallyltryptamine , also known as N-methyl-N-allyltryptamine, is a lesser-known psychedelic drug from the tryptamine family.

156855755.name: IAG933
156855755.description: IAG933 is an investigational new drug that is being evaluated for the treatment of cancer.

164763851.name: LME-54
164763851.description: LME-54, or simply LME, also known as lysergic acid methylethylamide or as N-methyl-N-ethyllysergamide, is a serotonergic psychedelic of the lysergamide family related to lysergic acid diethylamide .

168429515.name: DODC
168429515.description: DODC is a psychedelic drug from the substituted amphetamine family which acts as an agonist of the 5-HT2A receptor.

170843467.name: Cerium monoselenide
170843467.description: Cerium monoselenide is an inorganic compound with the chemical formula CeSe. It exists in the form of Ce3+Se2− .

172990283.name: Iso-butomidate
172990283.description: Iso-butomidate is an anesthetic drug related to etomidate, which has been sold as a designer drug as an active ingredient in e-cigarette liquids marketed under names such as space oil or kpods.

177378251.name: YC8-02
177378251.description: YC8-02 is a drug which acts as a potent inhibitor of the enzymes sirtuin 2 and sirtuin 3 .

900000203.name: Atacicept
900000203.description: Atacicept, sold under the brand name Trutakna, is a medication used for the treatment of proteinuria in immunoglobulin A nephropathy.

900000331.name: Bupropion/zonisamide
900000331.description: Bupropion/zonisamide (former tentative brand name Empatic, Excalia) is an experimental combination of bupropion which was under development for the treatment of obesity.

900000459.name: Chloryl tetraperchloratoaurate
900000459.description: Chloryl tetraperchloratoaurate is an inorganic chemical compound with the formula [ClO2]+[Au 4]− consisting of the chloryl cation and a tetraperchloratoaurate anion.

900000587.name: Desloratadine/pseudoephedrine
900000587.description: Desloratadine/pseudoephedrine, sold under the brand name Clarinex-D among others, is a medication used for the treatment of seasonal allergic rhinitis.

900000843.name: Fluoxakalner
900000843.description: Fluoxakalner is a Kv7.2 and Kv7.3 potassium channel opener which is under investigation for potential medical use.

900001227.name: Magnesium polonide
900001227.description: Magnesium polonide is a salt of magnesium and polonium. It is a polonide, a set of very chemically stable compounds of polonium.

900001355.name: Neptunyl fluoride
900001355.description: Neptunyl fluoride is an inorganic compound of neptunium, oxygen, and fluorine with the chemical formula NpO2F2.

900001483.name: Pariglasgene brecaparvovec
900001483.description: Pariglasgene brecaparvovec, sold under the brand name Genglycos, is a gene therapy medication used for the treatment of glycogen storage disease type Ia.

900001611.name: Poly(p-phenylene vinylene)
900001611.description: Poly is a conducting polymer of the rigid-rod polymer family.

900001867.name: Sevirumab
900001867.description: Sevirumab is a human monoclonal antibody for the treatment of infections with cytomegalovirus in patients with AIDS.

900001995.name: Temelimab
900001995.description: Temelimab is an experimental monoclonal antibody drug for immune system conditions that neutralizes the human endogenous retrovirus envelope protein HERV-W.
